prediction_text: Prediction: Labour under Keir Starmer win the UK general election of 4 July 2024, by a large majority. A roughly twenty-point polling lead five weeks out, a snap election called from weakness, and a governing party publicly damaged (the D-Day memorial episode) leave no plausible path for Sunak's Conservatives; the Cancer-season election turns the government out. (Unit: day; election day fixed by the question.)

Material as given: snap election called 22 May for 4 July 2024; Labour leads by ~20 points; Sunak criticised for leaving the D-Day service early; election falls in Sun-sign Cancer. Method: the mundane frame (a Cancer election — the sign of home/people — rewarding the change-of-household party) merely corroborates what the card's factual structure already compels: a 20-point lead at this distance is beyond any recorded late swing, so the graded claim 'large majority' is carried by the polling datum itself (pointer count 2: lead size + incumbent-damage fact). Fact-priority is decisive here. R61-REV1-2: primary path = polling structure; second path = incumbent-damage/momentum analysis; converge on Labour, large. R61-REV1-4: 'large majority' is a magnitude claim with 2 pointers, retained without a seat figure (no pointer — omitted).
